notes.title: delays (sorry lol) + cool news!?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44166977/60293c28028bf50fee9bc1666519a79b05982721.gif[/img]
[h1]hi cool ppl who are following this project.[/h1]

wanted to keep folks in the loop with how things are going re: full version of Small Town Emo.


[h2]bad news / delays etc:[/h2]

in order to get the game in a healthy spot we made the call to update from GB Studio version 3.03 to 3.21. this provided a bunch of bugfixes and new features ((mentioned [url=https://github.com/chrismaltby/gb-studio/blob/develop/CHANGELOG.md#320---2024-01-29]here[/url])) BUUUUUUT came at the cost of breaking a bunch of stuff!!!

because this game is a part-time side project, lots of dev time has gone into fixing things, which has delayed the release goal. sadly there's still more *~elbow grease~* needed to get up and running again. PLUS there's a chunk of art that still needs art-ing, and some music that needs 2 b musicked... which brings us to our other (cooler) news:


[url=https://img.itch.zone/aW1nLzE1OTUyNjQ2LnBuZw==/original/7rAKzN.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44166977/5ab250bb0f072ab4ac73dd15225814c5b41a64e4.png[/img][/url]

[h2]collabing w/ robot meadows + others:[/h2]

we're really excited to be commissioning some ~originale~ tracks from Robot Meadows 2 add 2 the awesome asset pack tracks weve been using from [url=https://victorvaldez.itch.io/]Mr V.[/url] and [url=https://beatscribe.itch.io/]Beatscribe[/url]. Robot Meadows makes fantastic music, plzzz check out their first album [url=https://robotmeadows.bandcamp.com/album/star-cycles-2]Star Cycles[/url].

we have ALSO reached out to a very cool pixel artist friend to create assets to help w/ the release. this will help get us back on track so thats something to lewk forward 2 (very excited)


[h2]TL;;DR[/h2]

release is delayed by X months. collaborating with some cool ppl to make it real good tho. sorry and thank you <3

notes.title: Small Town Emo is a NZ Game Awards Finalist!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44166977/87096e4ed5532a5ff1cf38a4a07222718a00592b.png[/img]
The Pavs (New Zealand Game Awards) are almost upon us, and Small Town Emo was nominated for four categories! What!?


[h1][b]ABOUT THE PAVS:[/b][/h1]

The Pavs are a celebration of Australia and NZ’s best and boldest game development achievements. Organised by the New Zealand Games Festival (NZGF), a grassroots not-for-profit whose purpose is to celebrate NZ and Australian games, and promote the industry as a “tool for social good and old fashioned fun”. 

The Pavs aim to the put a spotlight on local games that have gone the extra mile to immerse, entertain and tantalise. Pavs finalists go in the running for a coveted trophy and this year have the opportunity to feature in the Kiwi Interactive Showcase at NZGDC.


[h1][b]ABOUT OUR NOMINATIONZ:[/b][/h1]

Small Town Emo managed to get nominations across four different categories! Bonkers. It’s made even more exciting by the calibre of other nominees that were chosen for The Pavs. We were nominated for the following categories:

[list][i][*] The ‘Slice of Heaven’ Grand Prize
[*] The Poetic Serving: Excellence in Narrative
[*] The Decorative Piece: Excellence in Visual Art
[*] The Diverse Delight: Excellence in Representation[/i][/list]
[h3]The ‘Slice of Heaven’ Grand Prize[/h3]

In the Slice of Heaven category there’s (of course) [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1562430/DREDGE/]Dredge[/url] by legendary local Ōtautahi team Black Salt Games — if you haven’t heard of Dredge you absolutely must. go. play. it! Also up for this big hot ~supreme~ Pav award is the intriguing tabletop game Ovation, who have a Kickstarter page you can take a sniff at if you like the sound of a late 18th century composer-themed deckbuilding game (which imo sounds v cool).

[h3]The Poetic Serving: Excellence in Narrative[/h3]

Alongside us in the Poetic Serving (narrative) category is The Ugly Club, which absolutely looks like the best idea ever: it’s an Aotearoa-based dating simulator where all of the characters are anthropomorphic wildlife from NZ. Weird/wild/hot stuff!

[h3]The Decorative Piece: Excellence in Visual Art[/h3]

We’re also in the visuals category alongside Dredge (again, [i]classic[/i] Dredge lol), Epicool Kai Karting (a charming racing game based on a Kiwi kids’ cartoon), [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1756770/Little_Robo_Climber/]Little Robo Climber[/url] (an adorable retro-platformer with detailed pixel art), and Neon Knives (a two player stealth PVP game with beautifulll graphics)

[h3]The Diverse Delight: Excellence in Representation[/h3]

This diversity category nomination is super near and dear to us. We’re up for a representation award against Epicool Kai Karting (bc that racing game has depth fr) and Sub-Verge which, based on its description, is a conversation-based relationship building game involving a character in slowly sinking submarine (very topical).

Check out the rest of the 2023 Pavs Finalists [url=https://nzgamesfest.com/the-pavs/2023-finalists/]here[/url]. It’s a fantastic list of really wicked (and very different) games from our corner of the globe. Hells yeah.

[url=https://nzgamesfest.com/the-pavs/2023-finalists/]nzgamesfest.com/the-pavs/2023-finalists[/url]

notes.title: We're a part of the 2023 Queer Games Bundle!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44166977/853e0c4ff04bf7c6d94b91dac34edb5e09e3f135.png[/img]

[h1]Small Town Emo is a part of the 2023 Queer Games Bundle! ❤️[/h1]

The 2023 Queer Games Bundle is a collection of games and artworks by queer creators promoted together across various platforms during the month of June. Proceeds raised through this bundle are distributed directly to queer creators participating in the initiative!

As beautifully stated by the team behind the bundle; [i]"[supporting] the Queer Games Bundle is a direct action that you can take right now to support queer people in a life-changing way... help nurture our diverse queer arts community, fund the creation of the next great game you love."[/i]

Many of the titles included in this bundle are available on Steam (including ours)!

Below, we've put together an incomplete list of awesome titles on Steam who are also participating in the 2023 Queer Games Bundle!
